<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial review of EC appointments:</strong> The Supreme Court has referred the legal challenge regarding the appointment process of Election Commissioners to a larger bench for further consideration.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxOMGx1SXA0clVOMnZaU1p3UWJGTEZjTlllU1U2cWxRZ21PUEJLbTV4RTQxVGc4OTNjbTJzNGUzR3pBRzBxdk4zTEdmNHlPazl1Zm5wbGRqS3hycV9jREp1aFlxeUVZLVFIZHdySXpVSVpjakx4aVRJMU8tclBMMlVJdmtIelE0YUt4YmVnaVlwX3ZiY1ltOFZkYkVwVVVRUEg2eWZV?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
